question: In which weight category did Nitu Ghanghas win the IBA Women's World Boxing Championship event, 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**48 kg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Nitu Ghanghas won the gold medal in the **48 kg weight category** at the IBA Women's World Boxing Championship 2023.
 
• The event took place in **New Delhi, India**.
 
• Nitu defeated **Lutsaikhan Altantsetseg** of Mongolia in the final with a unanimous decision.
 
• She became the **sixth Indian woman** to win a gold medal at the IBA Women's World Boxing Championship.
 
• India hosted the event, showcasing the country's rising dominance in women's boxing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IBA Women's World Boxing Championship**: An international boxing competition organized by the International Boxing Association (IBA), featuring female boxers from various countries.
 
• **48 kg weight category**: A light flyweight class in boxing where athletes must weigh less than or equal to 48 kg.
 
• **Nitu Ghanghas**: An Indian boxer who has consistently performed well in national and international events, further establishing India's reputation in boxing.
 
• **India's dominance in boxing:** Indian women have won several medals in global boxing championships, reflecting the country's growing expertise and investment in the sport.
 
• **Sports infrastructure in India:** Hosting international events like the IBA championship highlights India's improved sports infrastructure and ability to organize world-class competitions.
